title: 16S rRNA Library Preparation for Illumina MiSeq
author: Somasundhari Shanmuganandam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6i7hchn
materials: The PCR reaction setup is given below ReagentsVolume (µl) for 25µl reactionTemplate DNAVaries (2.5-25 ng per 25 µL reaction)Water, nuclease-free Upto 25µL5X SuperFi™ Buffer15 µL10 mM dNTP mix 0.5 µL 10 µM forward primer 1.25 µL10 µM reverse primer 1.25 µLPlatinum™ SuperFi™ DNA Polymerase (2 U/µL0.25 µL5X SuperFi™ GC Enhancer (optional)5µL Add reagents and DNA in a sterilised PCR tube in the order given above
Bring the AMPure XP beads to room temperature.
Thaw MiSeq reagent cartridge in 25°C water bath
Invert reagent cartridge and buffer bottle to mix

steps.title: Perform Amplicon PCR
steps.instruction: Run the initial PCR using the following cycle conditions: initial denaturation at 98°C for 30 sec; 25 cycles of 98°C for 10 sec, 55°C for 15 sec, and 72°C for 30 sec; final extension at 72°C for 10 min.

steps.title: Prepare Ethanol Wash Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare two Axygen plates, each with wells containing 200 μl of 80% ethanol.

steps.title: Perform First Stage Bead Clean-up
steps.instruction: Clean the Amplicon PCR product using AMPure XP beads and a Coppin magnetic device.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire Amplicon PCR product to the Axygen plate using a multichannel pipette set to 20 μl, changing tips between samples.
Vortex AMPure XP beads for 30 seconds to ensure even dispersion.
Add 20 μl of AMPure XP beads (1:1 ratio) to each well.
Gently pipette the entire volume up and down 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature without shaking for 5 minutes.
Place a sheath on the Coppin device and insert into the plate wells.
Allow beads to bind for 2 mins, then use the device to transfer beads to the first ethanol plate.
Transfer beads to the second ethanol half plate.
Remove beads from ethanol using the Coppin device and invert on the bench so beads face up.
Air dry at room temperature for 10 minutes while still on the Coppin device.

steps.title: Elute Cleaned Product
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the beads using Tris buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 52.5 μl of 10 mM Tris pH 8.5 (Buffer EB) to each well of the Amplicon PCR plate using a multichannel pipette; cover when not in use.
Insert the sheath (with air-dried beads still on the device) into the Tris well and remove the Coppin device, leaving the sheath in the solution.
Resuspend beads by gently swishing the sheath in the Tris (if beads stick, use a magnetic base to remove them and remove the plate immediately).
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes without shaking.
Put a fresh sheath on the Coppin device and insert into the Tris for 2 mins.
Remove and discard the beads and the sheath.
Transfer the cleaned-up product from the well into a PCR tube using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Verify First Stage Product
steps.instruction: Check the size of the cleaned-up product via gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Run 5 µL of cleaned-up product in 1% agarose gel for 20 mins at 100V to check for a band at ~500 bp.
Run 5 µL of original PCR product in 1% agarose gel for 20 mins at 100V to check for a band at ~460 bp.

steps.title: Perform Indexing PCR (Stage 2)
steps.instruction: Add barcodes using the Nextera XT Index Kit (N7XX and S5XX) with the following reaction setup (50 µl total volume):

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction: Water (nuclease-free) up to 50 µl, 10 µl of 5X SuperFi™ Buffer, 5 µl of each 2 µM primer, 5 µl Template, 0.5 µl Platinum™ SuperFi™ DNA Polymerase (2 U/µL), and 1 µl of 10 mM dNTP mix.
Run PCR cycles: Initial denaturation at 98°C for 30 sec; 8 cycles of 98°C for 10 sec, 55°C for 15 sec, and 72°C for 30 sec; final extension of 10 min at 72°C.

steps.title: Perform Second Stage Bead Clean-up
steps.instruction: Repeat the bead clean-up process (as described in the first stage) with modified volumes.

substeps.instruction: Use 45 μl of AMPure XP beads instead of 20 μl.
Use 27.5 μl of 10 mM Tris pH 8.5 instead of 52.5 μl.

steps.title: Verify and Quantify Stage 2 Product
steps.instruction: Validate the indexed library size and concentration.

substeps.instruction: Run 5 µL of PCR product in 1% agarose gel for 20 mins at 100V to check for a band at ~550 bp.
Run 5 µL of PCR product in 1% agarose gel for 20 mins at 100V and compare it to the stage 1 clean-up product to verify the size increase from barcodes.
Quantify the stage 2 PCR product using the Qubit high sensitivity assay.
Run TapeStation on selected samples to check length.

steps.title: Pool and Normalize Library
steps.instruction: Pool samples to a specific molar concentration.

substeps.instruction: Pool equimolar volumes of each sample to achieve a final concentration of 4 nM (1.17 ng/μl).
Verify the pooled sample concentration is 4 nM (1.17 ng/μl) using the Qubit high sensitivity assay.

steps.title: Denature Pooled Library
steps.instruction: Denature the pooled library using NaOH.

substeps.instruction: Thaw HT1 reagent and pooled library at room temperature and store on ice.
Prepare 0.2N NaOH by mixing 800 μl of dH2O and 200 μl of 1N NaOH.
Combine 5 μl of pooled library with 5 μl of 0.2N NaOH (work quickly).
Vortex briefly and centrifuge for 1 min at 300 g.
Incubate for 5 mins at room temperature immediately after centrifugation.
Immediately add 990 μl of pre-chilled HT1 to the denatured DNA and place on ice (resulting in 20 pM denatured library).

steps.title: Dilute Library and PhiX
steps.instruction: Dilute the denatured library and PhiX control to the final loading concentration.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 20 pM dilution of PhiX.
Dilute denatured library to 9.5 pM by adding 285 μl of denatured library to 315 μl of pre-chilled HT1 (final volume 600 μl).
Invert to mix, pulse centrifuge, and place on ice.
Dilute 20 pM denatured PhiX to the same concentration by adding 285 μl of 20 pM denatured PhiX to 315 μl pre-chilled HT1.
Invert to mix, pulse centrifuge, and place on ice.

steps.title: Final Library Mix and Loading
steps.instruction: Combine library with PhiX and load onto the Illumina MiSeq.

substeps.instruction: Combine 60 μl of denatured, diluted PhiX with 540 μl of denatured diluted library.
Incubate the combined library at 96°C for 2 min.
Invert several times to mix and place on ice immediately.
Load the sample into the reagent cartridge.
Wash the flow cell with water, dry, and wash with ethanol.
Load the flow cell, reagent cartridge, buffer bottle, and waste bottle into the MiSeq, ensure the sample sheet is loaded, and start the run.
